home.title: Welcome to Match & Watch
home.intro: The app that settles once and for all the question "What are we watching tonight?" — well, almost.
home.step1: 1. Create or join a room with your friends. A 4-letter code, and you're in.
home.step2: 2. Swipe the films based on your filters. Like what you want to see, ignore the rest.
home.step3: 3. Vote for your favourites among the films everyone liked.
home.step4: 4. Discover the winner — the film that scored the most points. And this time, no excuse to bail halfway.
home.filterVoteText: Each participant votes for their preferences (genres, year, duration…). The median of the votes is applied — democracy, but make it work.

filterVote.title: Vote for your preferences
filterVote.intro: Each participant picks their own search criteria. Don't worry, nobody's going to judge your taste… well, it depends on what you pick.
filterVote.calcSliders: Sliders (rating, year, popularity, duration) — the median of all votes is used. A reasonable filter for everyone, rather than a dictatorship of the most demanding.
filterVote.calcGenres: Genres — the union. If at least one person wants thrillers, thrillers stay on the list. Solidarity.
filterVote.timerText: You have {time} to vote. After that, your default preferences are submitted. They're reasonable, we promise. But you could have done better.

swipe.title: Swipe time
swipe.swipeText: Left if you don't want to see this film. Right if you're in. You know the drill.
swipe.quotaText1: The number of films to like is shown at the top of the page. You keep swiping until you reach your quota or run out of films.
swipe.quotaText2: If the films run out before you reach your quota, the list was just short. Too bad — you work with what fate (and the filters) gave you.
swipe.randomText: Everyone sees the same films, but in a different order. No point trying to copy your neighbour.
swipe.timerText: You have {time} to swipe. When it hits zero, your bucket is submitted as is, even if incomplete. Swipe fast.

vote.title: The final vote
vote.intro: Here you'll find all the films liked by at least one person in the room. Even the one you swiped left on. Yes, someone liked it. You know who.
vote.howIntro: Under each film, 5 buttons to express your level of enthusiasm:
vote.ratingNeutral: · Neutral — you don't care, but you're here anyway
vote.ratingTop: ❤️ Top — you've been waiting for this for weeks
vote.synopsisText: Can't remember what this film is about? Tap the poster to show the synopsis. And no, you don't have a good excuse to vote blind.
vote.timerText: You have {time} to vote. After that, your vote is submitted automatically with your current ratings. Don't procrastinate.
vote.validateText: Once you've rated all the films, click "Vote" at the bottom of the page. The result will then be revealed to everyone.
